purpose.zh: 拉伸大腿内侧和后侧，适合办公室做
purpose.en: Stretch the inner and back of your thighs, office-friendly.

text.zh: 背部拉长，从髋部前折，双手扶椅面
text.en: Keep your back long, fold from your hips and rest your hands on the chair seat

text.zh: 双脚宽距站立，脚尖朝前，膝盖不锁死
text.en: Stand with feet wide, toes forward, knees long but not locked.

text.zh: 呼气时臀部稍后坐，胸口下沉
text.en: As you exhale, sit your hips back a little and let your chest sink.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back and reaching for the floor.

cautions.zh: 起身要慢，头晕时先停下；拉伸处疼痛时减小幅度
cautions.en: Come up slowly and stop if you feel dizzy; ease off if the stretch hurts.
